title: Traditional Ukrainian Rhubarb Pilaf
description: A hearty pilaf dish infused with the sweet and tart flavors of rhubarb, inspired by Ukrainian cuisine.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Pour in 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the rhubarb and continue to simmer for 10 more minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
